items.title: The licence type exists in Mynt's regulatory model
items.requirement: The regulator and licence type the firm names are defined by Mynt's admins for this region.

items.title: Listed on the regulator's public register
items.requirement: The regulator's official register (or an official list it publishes) shows an entry for this registration number.

items.title: Held by this firm
items.requirement: The register entry's holder is this firm: the legal name matches, allowing for punctuation, case and common abbreviations (Ltd/Limited, Pvt/Private).

items.title: The right kind of licence
items.requirement: The register shows the registration is of the licence type the firm claims (for example, an NBFC registration rather than another category).

items.title: In force
items.requirement: The register shows the registration as current: not cancelled, surrendered, suspended or expired, and consistent with the validity dates the firm gave.

items.title: No serious enforcement action
items.requirement: The regulator's published enforcement orders, cancellations or penalties name no action against this registration in the last three years, or any found are minor and resolved.
